dz: 亚历山德里亚第20任教皇阿塔纳修斯被放逐到特里尔,罪名是他阻止一粮食舰队出海去君士坦丁堡.
de: Athanasius, 20th pope of Alexandria, is banished to Trier on the charge that he prevented a grain fleet from sailing to Constantinople.
